CameraTriggerController.description:
Represents a CameraTriggerController module on a BehaviorBoard device.

The two camera trigger outputs share pins with digital outputs: Trigger0 is DO0 and Trigger1
is DO1. A trigger that is not enabled is never started, which leaves its pin free for a pulse
output such as a reward valve.

trigger0Enabled.description: Start camera trigger 0 (CameraOutput0, the DO0 pin) when the rig starts.
trigger0Enabled.title: Trigger0Enabled

trigger0Frequency.description: The frequency, in Hz, at which to emit camera triggers on Trigger0 (DO0, CameraOutput0)
trigger0Frequency.title: Trigger0Frequency

trigger1Enabled.description: Start camera trigger 1 (CameraOutput1, the DO1 pin) when the rig starts. Leave off when DO1 drives a pulse output.
trigger1Enabled.title: Trigger1Enabled

trigger1Frequency.description: The frequency, in Hz, at which to emit camera triggers on Trigger1 (DO1, CameraOutput1). Only matters when trigger 1 is enabled.
trigger1Frequency.title: Trigger1Frequency

CameraTriggerController.title: CameraTriggerController

PulseOutputs.description:
The pulse source of each behavior board digital output line. Each line appears once.

All three lines are required: a union has no default that survives code generation, so an
unused line is written as a FixedPulse with a width of 0.
